topic: How do on-board storage constraints influence payload power allocation between immediate and time-tagged service prioritization?
consensus_response: On-board storage constraints directly impact payload power allocation by influencing the balance between immediate services (no on-board memory) and time-tagged services (requiring buffer storage).  Efficient compression techniques like RLE reduce data size for both, but immediate service prioritization demands careful management of signaling overhead to avoid overloading. Network protocols like QoS-OSPF with RSVP-TE dynamically adjust data rates based on real-time resource constraints for improved power efficiency and capacity utilization.
